heroHeadline: Russia Kills 6 in Merefa Ballistic Strike; Ukraine Hits Primorsk Oil Port and Luxury Moscow High-Rise 5 Days Before Victory Day
heroSubtitle: An Iskander-M ballistic missile struck the town of Merefa in Kharkiv Oblast on May 4 at 09:35, killing 6 civilians including two teenagers aged 16 and 17 and wounding 36 others. Overnight May 2–3, Russia launched a mega-barrage of 268 drones plus one Iskander-M, killing 4 in Kherson and Chornomorsk and damaging 35 homes. In response, Ukraine struck Primorsk — Russia's largest Baltic crude oil export terminal — with 60+ UAVs; NASA satellites confirmed fires, and 70+ St. Petersburg flights were disrupted. Ukraine also hit Tuapse oil refinery for the 4th time in 16 days and shadow fleet tankers. On May 3–4, a Ukrainian drone struck a luxury Moscow high-rise 6 km from the Kremlin, 5 days before Victory Day — Russia's parade will feature no military vehicles for the first time in ~20 years. Zelensky attended the 8th European Political Community summit in Yerevan (Armenia) holding bilateral meetings on air defense and a comprehensive ceasefire. ISW confirmed Russian forces suffered their first net territorial loss since August 2024 Kursk incursion; cumulative Russian losses now exceed 1.335 million. Trump's ceasefire push remains stalled — Ukraine insists on a long-term agreement, not a Victory Day parade pause.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Euronews, and RBC-Ukraine. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
